help:
Usage: rio init [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --endpoint <ENDPOINT>
          

      --token-stdin
          

      --github-app
          Register a GitHub App for PR mode after deploying (skippable; replayed by --from)

      --github-org <ORG>
          Register the app under this GitHub organization instead of your account

      --replace-private-key <PEM>
          Store a new private key (PEM file) for the registered app on the endpoint

      --no-tui
          Prompt on the terminal instead of opening the interactive UI (also `RIO_TUI=0`)

      --from <FROM>
          Reproduce deployment choices from a Rio user config (contains no secrets)

      --account <ACCOUNT>
          

      --name <NAME>
          

      --cf-profile <CF_PROFILE>
          

      --runner <RUNNER>
          [possible values: sandbox, self-hosted]

      --runner-image <RUNNER_IMAGE>
          Local Docker image, public image, or an existing registry.cloudflare.com reference

      --workers-subdomain <WORKERS_SUBDOMAIN>
          Account subdomain to register if the account has none; existing subdomains are reused

      --credential-store <CREDENTIAL_STORE>
          Default: OS keychain. Use file explicitly on a headless host
          
          [possible values: keychain, file]

      --secrets-file <SECRETS_FILE>
          Private JSON file containing model provider keys, AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN or AI_GATEWAY_PROVIDER_KEY_<SLUG> custom provider keys; never copied to config

      --custom-provider <SLUG:PROTOCOL:BASE_URL>
          Add or replace a custom AI Gateway provider: SLUG:PROTOCOL:BASE_URL, where PROTOCOL is openai or anthropic and BASE_URL is the API root that /chat/completions or /messages is appended to. Repeatable

      --default-model <MODEL>
          Generation model for a newly written personal default profile, e.g. custom-SLUG/MODEL; required with custom providers when that profile is absent

      --verifier-model <MODEL>
          Verification model for a newly written personal default profile (defaults to --default-model)

      --dry-run
          Print an offline plan without authentication, credential writes or account mutations

      --council-vendor <VENDOR:FAMILY:ROUTE>
          Allow a council vendor: VENDOR:FAMILY:ROUTE, where ROUTE is a model route such as anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5 or custom-SLUG/MODEL. Repeatable; replaces the saved council allowlist. Built-in provider routes need that provider's key from the environment or --secrets-file

      --no-council
          Skip the council step and clear any saved council allowlist

  -h, --help
          Print help
